keywords: Lifelong Sports 2.Basketball 3.Fundamental of offensive B.B.skills 4.B.B.game analysis 5.Life style
educationalGoal: By studying the fundamental skills of BBall, students will learn the following: 1. Knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on plan-do-check-action cycle. 2. Necessities for social/student life such as observation of the rules, respect and kindness for others, challenging spirit, leadership/cooperation, sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through the learning of Basketball activities. Specifically, students will learn the following: 1. Understanding about Basketball (1) Knowledge about Basketball (history, characteristics of B.B.game) (2) fundamental technical terms of Basketball (3) the rules of the B.B.game 2. Learning fundamental skills of Basketball (1) Understanding about 1x1 offense Play (Dribble change, Shoot) (2) Understanding about 2x2 offense Play (Give and go play Screen play) (3)Understanding about 3x3 offense Play (Screen away play, UCLA cut play) 3.5x5 game (Analyzing some games to improve team and individual performance) 4. Sport event plan and management ※A once a-week 100-minutes lesson. ※Students aim to attend all classes with high motivation to learn. ※Students should pay attention to their own health condition, and need to participate the class with Willingness to learn fundamental skills of Basketball more actively. ※On a hot day, students should prepare adequate sports drinks to stay hydrated.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying a sports life throughout their own lifetime.
Be able to get various fundamental skills of tennis, and to use them in the class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain their own situations and improvements in sports activities based on PDCA.
Be able to understand necessities for social life and to implement them in the class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this undrstanding in learning.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3)Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5)Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: Course guidance for understanding the outlines of Class. Fundamental offensive skills of Basketball (shooting, dribbling, passing). Fundamental offensive skills for 2x2 game situation. Use learned skills with game like practice.
lessons.operation: Lecture and practice Distributing documents including syllabus. Make some groups for learning. Practice with 2x2 situation (Screen pick & roll play, Give & go play). Play 2x2 game like practice.
lessons.assignments: Review: Read a document to understand the content of class. Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Fundamental offensive skills for 2x2 game situation. Use learned skills with 2x2 game like practice.
lessons.operation: Practice with 3x0 and 3x3 situation (Away screen play, UCLA cut play). Play 3x3 game like practice.
lessons.assignments: Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Understanding contents learned by playing 3x3 game like practice. Understanding 5 men running play to know BBall position.
lessons.operation: Play 3x3 tournaments game. Play 5x5 game like practice.
lessons.assignments: Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list. Report1(about BB rules) Preparation: Find out about how to make league games.

lessons.content: Confirm understanding of class contents1 to 3 per team. Organize reflection points and use them at 5x5 game like practice.
lessons.assignments: Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list.

lessons.content: Confirm understanding of class contents4 per team. Organize reflection points and use them at 5x5 game like practice.
lessons.assignments: Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list. Report1(about own 5x5 game analysis and own team play improvements) Preparation: Find out about how to make tournament games.

lessons.content: Confirm understanding of class contents5 per team. Organize reflection points and use them at 5x5 game like practice. Lecture about sports event management.
lessons.operation: Play 5x5game like practice (use tournament). Submit report2.
lessons.assignments: Homework: Make a lifestyle self-administration list. Review: review to prepare for the quiz (comprehension of game rules, fundamental of offense skills, tactics of game, sport event management).

lessons.content: Class summary. Answer the quiz. Answer class questionnaire. Confirmation of achievement, absences and submit reports. Play 5x5 game like practice
lessons.operation: Class summary. Answer the quiz. Answer class questionnaire. Confirmation of achievement, absences and submit reports. Play 5x5game like practice
